answer: Registration's zenith is a nonrefundable burn of 10 tokens per permanent key; the payer is the registrant, and an on-chain burn receipt verifies it. N fake identities cost exactly 10N tokens, a linear irreversible loss, not a returnable stake. Any identity reset mints a new key in the garden, requiring another 10-token burn; renaming cannot escape this nebula-wide per-key fee.
